scope: Selected public municipal QPR reporting quarters, independently indexed by HUD; exact published F31 activity identifiers plus separately labeled QPR-only NYC administrative/planning IDs, with no inferred crosswalk. Do not add QPR snapshots to F31 or add to-date values across quarters.

method.acquisition: Selected HUD public directRecipient-indexed PDF URLs; selected complete calendar-year windows where available. Existing horizon reports excluded; this is not exhaustive.
method.grant_and_period: Original PDF cover and HUD review status independently checked. Original QPR source URL, source page and SHA-256 retained. One unreadable HUD PDF is excluded; absence of an accepted report is not evidence that no report exists.
method.monetary_values: All 5,508 accepted activity monetary cells extracted from the correct PDF row and period/to-date columns by coordinate. Independent Poppler layout checks cover all whole-grant cells, all 61 report identities/statuses/award headers, and 243 stratified activity records. Negative adjustments are preserved.
method.budget: Activity Total Budget can include program income and is not a beneficiary-city allocation. Overall grant Total Budget is a programmed budget, not an independently verified historical allocation denominator.
method.award: Grant Award Amount is the value printed on the QPR cover in that specific report version; it is not asserted to be the initial agreement amount or an allocation at an award-relative horizon.
method.geography: City identifies the administering grantee by the original award ID. It does not establish activity or beneficiary location. Household addresses and raw narratives are not published.
method.identity: 878 activity records have an exact existing F31 award/project/activity match. Forty historical NYC administration/planning records retain source QPR IDs only and have no inferred F31 crosswalk. For the 429 exact activity-quarter matches, 858 period expenditure/obligation cells were compared and all agree; other amounts and quarters were not tested by that comparison.
method.time: Q1 is the potentially partial calendar quarter containing a verified initial agreement date. Missing start dates or beneficiary-city allocations remain null. QPR to-date columns are snapshots and may not be summed across quarters or combined with F31 transaction flows.
method.transformer: An offline MiniLM-L6-v2 pass indexed 3,184 nonblank pages from all 62 retrieved PDFs and ran three document-scoped queries per PDF. Similarity is a recall aid only; it establishes no fact and does not guarantee completeness. One PDF that the independent PDF reader could not open remains excluded.

excluded_reports.reason: Independent PDF reader could not open this HUD source; values are excluded. A different official archive may contain another version.
